purpose: Prepared (NOT applied) mail-authentication DNS changes for matflow.studio. Checked by tests/unit/sec-e2-mail-records.test.ts. Applying them is Noe's action in Vercel DNS.

observed.source: Google DNS-over-HTTPS (dns.google/resolve), passive; no request to any MatFlow host

records.name: resend._domainkey.matflow.studio
values: p=<RSA public key, 1024-bit DER prefix MIGfMA0G…>

notes: The wildcard * ALIAS (Vercel default) answers A for any label; TXT on any label is empty (NODATA).
No apex MX: nothing can receive mail at an @matflow.studio address, so a DMARC rua on matflow.studio would bounce.

assumptions.fromDomain: matflow.studio (RESEND_FROM is a Sensitive Vercel variable and was not read; Noe confirms from a received message header)

proposed.name: matflow.studio
proposed.condition: Only if no service sends with an envelope sender at the bare apex. Resend uses send.matflow.studio, a different name, so its SPF is unaffected. If a mailbox provider is later added for the apex, replace this single record with that provider's SPF (never add a second SPF record).

proposed.when: now; hold at least 14 days of aggregate reports
proposed.name: _dmarc.matflow.studio
proposed.condition: The rua address must be able to receive mail. An address on another domain is only honoured if that domain publishes matflow.studio._report._dmarc.<its-domain> (RFC 7489 §7.1) — hosted DMARC report services do this; a personal Gmail address does not.

proposed.when: after stage 1 reports show Resend mail passing DKIM and SPF aligned, and no unknown legitimate sender
proposed.name: _dmarc.matflow.studio
proposed.value: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; pct=25; rua=mailto:REPLACE-WITH-REPORT-ADDRESS; adkim=r; aspf=r
proposed.condition: Raise pct to 100 after 7 clean days.

proposed.when: after at least 30 days at p=quarantine; pct=100 with clean reports
proposed.name: _dmarc.matflow.studio
proposed.condition: Rollback at any stage = edit the record back to the previous stage (TTL-bound).
